title: EU finance ministers want DLT Pilot Regime cap raised to €300bn. Lagarde objects
message_html: EU finance ministers want DLT Pilot Regime cap raised to €300bn. Lagarde objects ...
snippet: On Friday the Council of the EU agreed the main elements of its negotiating position on the market integration and supervision package (MISP), aimed at integrating European capital markets.
